stages.name: Enterprise Intake
stages.description: Enterprise Intake stage in the EOS enterprise onboarding and DTA assimilation pipeline.
stages.recommendedAction: Confirm source scope before classification.

stages.name: Source Classification
stages.description: Source Classification stage in the EOS enterprise onboarding and DTA assimilation pipeline.
risks: Unlinked external repositories may delay extraction
stages.recommendedAction: Classify remaining source material before extraction.

stages.name: Enterprise Object Extraction
stages.description: Enterprise Object Extraction stage in the EOS enterprise onboarding and DTA assimilation pipeline.
risks: Extraction is currently structured and seeded, not AI-generated
stages.recommendedAction: Validate extracted object candidates with enterprise owners.

stages.name: Relationship Mapping
stages.description: Relationship Mapping stage in the EOS enterprise onboarding and DTA assimilation pipeline.
stages.recommendedAction: Review asset, system, process, and people relationships.

stages.name: Digital Mirror Creation
stages.description: Digital Mirror Creation stage in the EOS enterprise onboarding and DTA assimilation pipeline.
stages.recommendedAction: Review the Digital Mirror and confirm missing relationships.

stages.name: DTA Candidate Identification
stages.description: DTA Candidate Identification stage in the EOS enterprise onboarding and DTA assimilation pipeline.
stages.recommendedAction: Prioritize DTA candidates by value potential and data readiness.

stages.name: Data Feed Requirement Mapping
stages.description: Data Feed Requirement Mapping stage in the EOS enterprise onboarding and DTA assimilation pipeline.
risks: Real-time feeds are not connected yet
stages.recommendedAction: Confirm required fields, cadence, quality, and fallback owners.

stages.name: Agent Assignment
stages.description: Agent Assignment stage in the EOS enterprise onboarding and DTA assimilation pipeline.
stages.recommendedAction: Review assigned agents and integration responsibilities.

stages.name: Human Validation
stages.description: Human Validation stage in the EOS enterprise onboarding and DTA assimilation pipeline.
risks: DTA formation is blocked until validation is complete
stages.recommendedAction: Complete the human validation checklist.

stages.name: DTA Formation
stages.description: DTA Formation stage in the EOS enterprise onboarding and DTA assimilation pipeline.
stages.recommendedAction: Prepare formation package after validation.

stages.name: Monitoring & Valuation
stages.description: Monitoring & Valuation stage in the EOS enterprise onboarding and DTA assimilation pipeline.
stages.recommendedAction: Enable monitoring and valuation only after DTA formation.
